propositions: rebar init silently creates an orphan branch when the configured tickets branch fetch fails or times out, instead of failing closed with diagnostics

the tri-state remote-branch probe must distinguish advertised (reachable), reachable-absent, and unreachable states, with unreachable triggering nonzero exit and no orphan creation unless --force-new-store override is supplied

all four init consumers (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share a single cached tri-state probe result keyed by repo/remote/branch to limit probe overhead to one per invocation

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount without raising, preserving force_new_store=False, while strict init paths reuse the cached result and fail with distinct remote/branch/timeout diagnostics

when the remote advertises the branch, a simulated bounded fetch failure must return nonzero and create no orphan; when reachable-absent, legitimate first-init bootstrap succeeds; when unreachable or timing out, explicit init and auto-init return nonzero within one probe timeout without entering consent prompts
